"Why... why can't I touch the sword!
  Could this power be...!

"You! That sword...
  Give me the Sword of Light!!

"I knew it. You're not my father...
  No... you're not even human.

"I sensed something was off.
  I've been close to the Heliodor king for
  decades. You couldn't fool my eyes.

"Holding a feast and passing as king...
  What a sly old raccoon dog.

"Hey! Come out, you coward!
  Impersonating the king, running around...
  how petty!

"He can't have gone far!
  {var:1}, let's chase him!
